description:
Convert a PDF document to EPUB ebook format. Supports automatic chapter detection, image extraction (Pro), and custom chapter grouping.

Free tier supports up to 10MB per PDF. Pro ($9/mo) is strongly recommended for PDF conversion — the 30MB limit handles most scanned or illustrated PDFs.
Upgrade at https://epublys.com/pricing

extractImages.description: Pro only — ignored on free tier

language.description: Language code for the output EPUB

name.description: Original filename — the output is named after its stem (e.g. "Book.epub" gives "Book (compressed).epub"); without it the output keeps a fixed name

pagesPerChapter.description: Pages per chapter (only for every-n mode)

name: pdf_to_epub
